driverSettings.title: [ur] Driver Settings
driverSettings.subtitle: [ur] Control your duty status, custom map navigation units, and road alerts.
driverSettings.activeDutyDesc: [ur] Toggle on to appear online and accept backhaul cargo matches.
driverSettings.audioAlertsDesc: [ur] Play a loud ringtone whenever a high-match route is offered.
driverSettings.autoNavigateDesc: [ur] Instantly pull up maps right after accepting a cargo load.
driverSettings.gpsSyncDesc: [ur] Allow dispatchers and buyers to track your truck location during a job.
driverSettings.nightModeDesc: [ur] Switch to a dark-charcoal UI to prevent eye fatigue while driving at night.

driverLoads.title: [ur] Available loads
driverLoads.subtitle: [ur] Loads assigned to you, awaiting response or in progress.
driverLoads.notVisible: [ur] You’re not accepting loads right now
driverLoads.nothingWaitingBody: [ur] When admin assigns you a load, it'll show up here for you to accept or reject.
driverLoads.noActiveLoadsBody: [ur] Loads you've accepted will show up here until they're delivered.

shipperSettings.title: [ur] Shipper Settings
shipperSettings.subtitle: [ur] Control your system preferences, API integrations, and display adjustments.
shipperSettings.milestoneAlertsDesc: [ur] Send real-time alerts whenever custom checks, pickups, or deliveries happen.
shipperSettings.erpSyncDesc: [ur] Restrict third-party software from fetching invoice and tracking data logs.
shipperSettings.darkModeDesc: [ur] Switch between standard light screen and cozy dark-room dashboard mode.

adminSettings.title: [ur] Admin Settings
adminSettings.subtitle: [ur] Control platform-wide configuration, moderation rules, and access policies.
adminSettings.newRegistrationsDesc: [ur] Allow new buyers, shippers, drivers, and agencies to sign up.
adminSettings.autoVerifyDriversDesc: [ur] Skip manual document review for drivers who were previously approved.
adminSettings.maintenanceModeDesc: [ur] Show a maintenance banner and pause new shipment/order matching platform-wide.
adminSettings.autoEscalateDesc: [ur] Flag complaints left open for more than 48 hours for priority review.
adminSettings.requireDocReviewDesc: [ur] Block a vehicle from accepting shipments until its documents are admin-verified.
adminSettings.twoFactorDesc: [ur] Require a secondary sign-in step for all admin accounts.
adminSettings.darkModeDesc: [ur] Switch between bright daylight screen and dark-charcoal mode.
